messages:
Maya (growth): Heads-up team  we need final hero + subhead variants for Hosted API, Dedicated, Private by Thursday. Also wire webinar CTA and ensure registration maps to the right AE queues. Quick ideation here please.
Alex (content): Kicking off copy ideas. Hosted (3):
- 'LLM APIs that behave like production services'
- 'Fast, predictable LLM responses—no infra required'
- 'Ship LLM features without building the stack'
Subheads (one of): 'Start with dev keys; scale to reserved or private deployments.'
Chris (design): Visual notes: Hosted hero should be compact with live latency KPI micro-card. Dedicated hero with a dark band and a short benchmark tag. Private hero emphasizing trust visuals (locks/keys).
Devon (ops): For Private, emphasize compliance bullets: 'KMS & HSM support', 'Audit logs & retention', 'Air-gapped deploys available'. Keep each bullet snappy.
Sam (demand): Webinar name proposal: 'From prototype to production: running LLMs at scale'. Form requirements: product_interest (values: Hosted, Dedicated, Private), utm_source, newsletter_opt_in (checkbox). Need hidden field product_interest on page variants.
Tara (PM): Can we add small UX tweak: on Dedicated page show two CTAs: 'Estimate cost' (leads to calc) and 'Talk to Sales'. For Hosted primary CTA remains 'Get API key'.
Alex (content): Shared supporting line ideas (pick one):
- 'A single inference platform across hosted, reserved, and private deployments.'
- 'Choose how you deploy. Keep the same API, tooling, and SLOs.'
- 'Production-grade inference where you need it.'
Chris (design): Microcopy under sign-up: 'Free dev keys, no credit card' or 'Start for free with dev credits' depending on existing promo. Also propose small trust strip on Private page: logos + compliance badges.
Maya (growth): Benchmarks: I want a short blurb on Dedicated: 'Example: p95 ~150ms on A100 (512 tokens); ~ $0.XX per 1k tokens'  only if legal ok and with hardware/model note. Nora (legal): OK as long as we include clear caveats and 'approximate' language and avoid absolute claims. Add: 'Benchmarks reflect internal tests; results may vary by model, token length, and infra.'
Devon (ops): We'll prepare standardized benchmark caption to plug in. Also will share exact sample command and measurement method for docs: `rrun --model=gpt-xx --seq=512 --rep=1000` (example).
Sam (demand): AE routing: I'll map product_interest to queues. For webinars, set lead_status = "webinar_reg" and notify AE via Slack DM. Need CMS to populate `product_interest` hidden input.
Alex (content): CTA label variants to test: 'Get API key', 'Start building', 'Request reserved capacity', 'Contact sales'. Keep copy short.
Chris (design): A/B test matrix idea: Hero variant (3) x CTA label (2) x benchmark present/absent (2) = 12 combos. We'll sample 5k visitors each for significance.
Maya (growth): Good. Tracking requirements: ensure form submits include `product_interest`, `utm_campaign`, and `variant_id`. Send to SFDC; set lead source = 'web'.
Tara (PM): Timeline: copy freeze Wed EOD, staging push Thu morning, QA Thu afternoon, go-live Fri. Owners: Alex (copy), Chris (design), Devon (benchmarks + staging form), Sam (tracking & AE mapping), Nora (legal quick review).
deploy-bot: Created ticket #DEVOPS-4309 for adding hidden fields and CORS updates. Staging form: https://staging.redwood.ai/forms/llm-launch - assigned to @dev-forms.
Nora (legal): I'll review benchmark wording and procurement language. Avoid phrasing like 'guaranteed' or 'industry-best'.
Alex (content): I'll assemble copy doc with three headline options per page, three shared supporting lines, CTA permutations, and microcopy for forms. Posting here when ready.
Maya (growth): Perfect. After staging push we'll run the A/B test for Hosted hero + CTA and the Dedicated benchmark blurb. Sam, set up dashboards for conversion -> SQL by product_interest.
Sam (demand): On it. Will create funnel dashboard and SQL tag filters.
Maya (growth): Thanks all 680
